user.title: Connect to the Hermes bridge
user.description: The Hermes add-on exposes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that fronts Venice.ai. Enter its address and the bridge token (state/assist_bridge.token in the Hermes profile).

data_description.url: For example http://0a6523c6-hermes-agent:8787/v1 — the add-on hostname works on the Home Assistant docker network.
data_description.token: Found on the Hermes side; the bridge rejects unauthenticated calls from other containers.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Hermes bridge. Is the add-on running and the port open?

init.title: Hermes Assist settings
init.description: Pick the Venice model and tell the assistant how to behave.

data_description.model: assist = Qwen3 8B (fastest, tool-capable) · assist-smart = GLM 5.3 Flash · assist-heretic = uncensored, tool-capable · assist-uncensored = chat only, no device control.
data_description.prompt: How the assistant should answer. Supports templates.
data_description.llm_hass_api: Select which tools the model may use to read state and control devices.
